title.description: Only on the start turn: Title of the adventure in the story language, max 5 words. Otherwise empty string.

narration.description: Narration in the story language, at most the ceiling the request gives under 'narration length per turn' and usually much shorter: one to three short sentences for a small action (eating, resting, looking around), a short paragraph or two for a normal action, the full ceiling only for big moments. Short paragraphs separated by a blank line. No numbers or game terms.

choices.description: Exactly 3 short actions in the story language (max 8 words each).

check.description: Hidden skill check for this turn.

attribute.description: Name of the hidden attribute used, or empty string.

attributes.description: Start turn: 4-6 hidden attributes that fit this hero. Later turns: only a NEW attribute for a newly gained power that no existing attribute covers (rare). Otherwise empty.

name.description: Attribute name in the story language.

hp.description: Damage this turn as a negative number (0 when none). Never use this for healing: use heal.

heal.description: Healing this turn, as a size. The app turns it into hit points. Empty string when the hero is not healed.

regen.description: The hero's natural self-healing. Empty string = unchanged (almost always). Only set it when the hero gains or loses a self-healing power.

gold.description: Exact change in money this turn, in the world's currency (negative = paying). Any size up to a billion, never rounded down.

completeQuests.description: Titles of open quests that are done this turn, copied exactly as written in the state. Required whenever the story finishes one.

location.description: Where the hero is now (short name in the story language), or empty string when unchanged.

addTraits.description: Powers or weaknesses the hero gains in the story this turn (not the ones in the player's own words). Same name again = updated description. Usually empty.

name.description: Short name in the story language, e.g. 'Windkracht', 'Schaduwstap', 'Bang voor vuur' (or 'Wind power', 'Shadow step', 'Fear of fire').

detail.description: One short sentence in the story language about what it does, max 15 words. No numbers.

removeTraits.description: Names of gained powers or weaknesses the hero loses this turn, copied exactly as written in the state. Required whenever the story takes one away.

summary.description: The plot so far in at most 120 words in the story language: the main thread, open threads and turning points. People, places and lasting facts live in cast and canon, so do not repeat them here.

gameOver.description: True only when the hero dies or the story truly ends.

image.description: Picture of this moment. Always fill prompt and fallback; show decides if the app makes the picture now.

show.description: True on the start turn, at a new location, when an important new character or boss appears, or at a spectacular action moment. Otherwise false.

kind.description: scene = place/situation, action = the hero doing something spectacular, character = an important new character.

prompt.description: English image prompt for this exact moment, 25-80 words. Include heroLook and cast looks of everyone visible. Concrete subject, action, setting, lighting, composition. No text, no names of real people or existing franchise characters, nothing graphic.

fallback.description: English, only the place of this moment without any people or creatures (very safe), 20-40 words.

heroLook.description: On the start turn: English description of the hero's visual appearance (20-40 words): everyday or stylish clothes, hair, face, build. Never a costume, suit with emblem, cape or mask. Otherwise empty string, unless the look changed or the given heroLook contains a costume.

portrait.description: Only on the start turn: English portrait prompt of the hero (head and shoulders, 25-50 words). Otherwise empty string.

cast.description: Recurring characters (not the hero) that are new this turn, missing from the cast, or whose look, status, home, role or note really changed. Empty when nothing changed. Empty string in a field = unchanged. Always return a character whose status changes (e.g. dies) or who moves house, even if their look is not known.

name.description: The character's name as used in the story (or a short label like 'de waard' / 'the innkeeper'). Use the name exactly as in the cast when they are already in it.

look.description: English, 15-35 words, always starting with age and gender (e.g. 'elderly woman in her seventies'), then build, face, hair, clothes. No costume, emblem, cape or mask. Empty string when unchanged or not known yet.

status.description: levend = alive, dood = dead, vermist = missing or fate unknown. 'dood' the same turn someone dies or is found dead. Empty string = unchanged.

home.description: Short, in the story language: where this person lives or stays (e.g. 'rood huis aan de rivier' / 'red house by the river'). Give it when it first becomes known and whenever it changes. Empty string = unchanged.

role.description: Short, in the story language: who this is to the hero or in the story (e.g. 'waard van De Gouden Os' / 'innkeeper of the Golden Ox', 'oude vijand' / 'old enemy'). Empty string = unchanged.

note.description: Short, in the story language (max 15 words): what must be remembered, e.g. how and where they died, a promise, a grudge. Empty string = unchanged.

companion.description: ja = travels with the hero now, nee = no longer with the hero. Empty string = unchanged.

canon.description: Changes to the canon sheet: fixed facts the story must never drift from. Only what is new or changed this turn.

places.description: Places that become established or change (a home, shop, base, hideout, district). Same name again = update. Empty when nothing changed.

name.description: Short name of the place in the story language.

detail.description: One short sentence in the story language: what it looks like, where it is, who lives or works there.

facts.description: New lasting facts: promises, debts, secrets (and who knows them), enemies, deals, curses. One short sentence each in the story language, max 20 words. Empty when none.

forgetFacts.description: Lasting facts that are resolved or no longer true this turn, copied exactly as written in the request. Empty when none.

time.description: Short marker of the moment in the story language, e.g. 'avond, tweede dag' / 'evening, second day' or 'vroege ochtend' / 'early morning'. Update it whenever time passes (a night's rest, a journey). Empty string when unchanged.
